evals.prompt: Create an AGENTS.md for this repo. It's a pnpm monorepo with apps/web (Next.js) and services/billing (Go). CI is in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Make it thorough, cover everything an agent might need.
evals.expected_output: Despite 'thorough', the agent inspects manifests and CI, writes a short root AGENTS.md with verified narrow commands and non-obvious rules, adds a nested AGENTS.md for services/billing only if its commands differ, and links CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md.
expectations: Reads package manifests and .github/workflows/ci.yml before writing
Lists narrow commands (single test file, typecheck) rather than only full-suite commands
Uses a separate nested AGENTS.md for services/billing (Go) or explains why not
Creates CLAUDE.md as a pointer (@AGENTS.md import or symlink) rather than a duplicated copy
Does not include generic advice or a directory tour

evals.prompt: Our CLAUDE.md is 380 lines and agents seem to ignore half of it. Clean it up.
evals.expected_output: The agent audits each line for non-obviousness and truth, verifies commands, cuts duplicated/generic/stale content, moves deep detail behind path references, and shows before/after line counts, asking before rewording the user's own rules.
expectations: Verifies listed commands or paths still exist before keeping them
Removes content that duplicates README/docs or restates linter config, replacing with path references where useful
Resulting file is under 100 lines, or the agent justifies any excess
Reports before and after line counts
Asks before changing the meaning of user-authored rules

evals.prompt: Agents keep running `npm install` in this repo and it breaks the lockfile, we use pnpm. Fix that for good.
evals.expected_output: The agent adds a short, specific rule to the agent context file (creating AGENTS.md with a CLAUDE.md pointer if none exists) and suggests an enforcement option such as `only-allow pnpm` in a preinstall script.
expectations: Adds a single explicit rule naming pnpm and forbidding npm/yarn install
Places it in AGENTS.md (with CLAUDE.md pointing to it) or the existing context file
Does not bloat the file with unrelated additions
Suggests a mechanical enforcement (e.g. preinstall only-allow, packageManager field) in addition to the prose rule
